findings.detail: Block 000406: source has no typographic emphasis for 'needs this'; Russian draft introduces italics around 'нужно'. Keep the narrator's force but avoid unsupported emphasis.

Block 000420: source emphasizes both 'did' and 'is' in 'Shane did ask ... and it is getting close to two'; Russian renders first italic but loses second emphatic reminder about the time. Restore both rhetorical beats.

Block 000430: source 'lets himself sink a little' means Ilya voluntarily submerges slightly; 'даёт себе немного утонуть в глубину' falsely implies drowning and is unnatural. Use 'даёт себе немного погрузиться глубже' while preserving scene.
